_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: jornada
constraints: CHECK (fin IS NULL OR fin >= inicio)

data.name: zona
constraints: CHECK (tipo_forma <> 'RADIAL' OR (centro_lat IS NOT NULL AND centro_lon IS NOT NULL AND radio_m IS NOT NULL))
CHECK (radio_m IS NULL OR radio_m BETWEEN 1 AND 3000)
CHECK ((centro_lat IS NULL OR centro_lat BETWEEN -90 AND 90) AND (centro_lon IS NULL OR centro_lon BETWEEN -180 AND 180))
CHECK (color IS NULL OR color GLOB '#[0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f]')

data.name: house_status
constraints: CHECK (prioridad = CASE color WHEN 'ENTREGA_Y_COBRANZA_PENDIENTE' THEN 1 WHEN 'COBRANZA_PENDIENTE' THEN 2 WHEN 'ENTREVISTA_PROGRAMADA' THEN 3 WHEN 'VENTA_COMPLETA' THEN 4 WHEN 'ENTREVISTA_SIN_VENTA' THEN 5 WHEN 'SIN_CONTESTAR' THEN 6 WHEN 'RECHAZO' THEN 7 END)

data.name: precio_por_ciudad
constraints: CHECK (valido_hasta IS NULL OR valido_hasta >= valido_desde)

data.name: precio_general
constraints: CHECK (valido_hasta IS NULL OR valido_hasta >= valido_desde)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "jornada" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "colportor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inicio" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fin" INTEGER NULL, "acompaniante_id" TEXT NULL, "tipo_acompaniamiento" TEXT NULL, "total_visitas" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_ventas" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (total_visitas >= 0), CHECK (total_ventas >= 0), CHECK (fin IS NULL OR fin >= inicio));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ubicacion" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "calle" TEXT NULL, "numero" TEXT NULL, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lon" REAL NOT NULL, "ciudad_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "zona_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (tipo IN ('CASA', 'NEGOCIO', 'EDIFICIO')), CHECK (lat BETWEEN -90 AND 90), CHECK (lon BETWEEN -180 AND 180));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "espacio" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ubicacion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "numero_depto" TEXT NULL, "piso" TEXT NULL, "descripcion" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ubicacion_par_decidido" ("ubicacion_a_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ubicacion_b_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "decision" TEXT NOT NULL, "decidido_en" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("ubicacion_a_id", "ubicacion_b_id"), CHECK (decision IN ('CONSERVAR_AMBOS', 'IGNORAR')), CHECK (ubicacion_a_id < ubicacion_b_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "campania_ciudad" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "campania_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ciudad_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "zona" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "campania_ciudad_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tipo_forma" TEXT NOT NULL, "centro_lat" REAL NULL, "centro_lon" REAL NULL, "radio_m" INTEGER NULL, "poligono_geojson" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (tipo_forma IN ('RADIAL', 'ESQUINAS')), CHECK (tipo_forma <> 'RADIAL' OR (centro_lat IS NOT NULL AND centro_lon IS NOT NULL AND radio_m IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (radio_m IS NULL OR radio_m BETWEEN 1 AND 3000), CHECK ((centro_lat IS NULL OR centro_lat BETWEEN -90 AND 90) AND (centro_lon IS NULL OR centro_lon BETWEEN -180 AND 180)), CHECK (color IS NULL OR color GLOB '#[0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f]'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "zona_vertice" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "zona_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "orden" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lon" REAL NOT NULL, "calle_a" TEXT NULL, "calle_b" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (lat BETWEEN -90 AND 90), CHECK (lon BETWEEN -180 AND 180));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sesion_usuario" ("usuario_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("usuario_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_log" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "evento" TEXT NOT NULL, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "motivo" TEXT NULL, "creado_en" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_queue" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_op_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NULL, "row_pk" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "message" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "depends_on" TEXT NULL, "done_at" INTEGER NULL, "claimed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (op IN ('insert', 'update', 'delete')), CHECK (state IN ('PENDING', 'IN_FLIGHT', 'INVALID', 'DONE', 'BLOCKED', 'WAITING')));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_watermark" ("scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "watermark" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("scope"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "persona" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "apellido" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "telefono" TEXT NULL, "notas_globales" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "espacio_persona" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "espacio_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "persona_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ubicacion_cobranza_alt_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nota" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "texto" TEXT NOT NULL, "categoria" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agenda" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "espacio_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "espacio_persona_id" TEXT NULL, "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "fecha_programada" INTEGER NOT NULL, "slot_codigo" TEXT NULL, "es_estricta" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("es_estricta" IN (0, 1)), "ubicacion_alt_id" TEXT NULL, "estado" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PROGRAMADA', "colportor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "visita_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (tipo IN ('ENTREVISTA', 'COBRANZA')), CHECK (estado IN ('PROGRAMADA', 'CUMPLIDA', 'NO_CUMPLIDA', 'CANCELADA')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "visita" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "espacio_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "espacio_persona_id" TEXT NULL, "fecha" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tipo_resultado" TEXT NOT NULL, "colportor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "jornada_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (tipo_resultado IN ('VENTA', 'NO_CONTESTO', 'RECHAZO', 'ENTREVISTA', 'COBRANZA')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "house_status" ("ubicacion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lon" REAL NOT NULL, "tipo_ubicacion" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "prioridad" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("ubicacion_id"), CHECK (tipo_ubicacion IN ('CASA', 'NEGOCIO', 'EDIFICIO')), CHECK (color IN ('ENTREGA_Y_COBRANZA_PENDIENTE', 'COBRANZA_PENDIENTE', 'ENTREVISTA_PROGRAMADA', 'VENTA_COMPLETA', 'ENTREVISTA_SIN_VENTA', 'SIN_CONTESTAR', 'RECHAZO')), CHECK (prioridad BETWEEN 1 AND 7), CHECK (prioridad = CASE color WHEN 'ENTREGA_Y_COBRANZA_PENDIENTE' THEN 1 WHEN 'COBRANZA_PENDIENTE' THEN 2 WHEN 'ENTREVISTA_PROGRAMADA' THEN 3 WHEN 'VENTA_COMPLETA' THEN 4 WHEN 'ENTREVISTA_SIN_VENTA' THEN 5 WHEN 'SIN_CONTESTAR' THEN 6 WHEN 'RECHAZO' THEN 7 END));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notificacion_historial" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "titulo" TEXT NOT NULL, "detalle" TEXT NULL, "destino" TEXT NULL, "recibida_en" INTEGER NOT NULL, "leida_en" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "producto" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "descripcion" TEXT NULL, "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "es_bonificable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("es_bonificable" IN (0, 1)), "es_misionero" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("es_misionero" IN (0, 1)), "precio_base_compra" INTEGER NULL, "casa_editora" TEXT NULL, "imagen_url" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (precio_base_compra IS NULL OR precio_base_compra >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coleccion" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "libros_a_elegir" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (libros_a_elegir >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "producto_coleccion" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "producto_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "coleccion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cantidad" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (cantidad > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "precio_por_ciudad" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "producto_id" TEXT NULL, "coleccion_id" TEXT NULL, "campania_ciudad_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "precio_venta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "valido_desde" TEXT NOT NULL, "valido_hasta" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((producto_id IS NULL) <> (coleccion_id IS NULL)), CHECK (precio_venta >= 0), CHECK (valido_hasta IS NULL OR valido_hasta >= valido_desde));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "precio_general" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "producto_id" TEXT NULL, "coleccion_id" TEXT NULL, "precio_venta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "valido_desde" TEXT NOT NULL, "valido_hasta" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((producto_id IS NULL) <> (coleccion_id IS NULL)), CHECK (precio_venta >= 0), CHECK (valido_hasta IS NULL OR valido_hasta >= valido_desde));
CREATE INDEX jornada_colportor_idx ON jornada (colportor_id, inicio)
CREATE INDEX ubicacion_ciudad_idx ON ubicacion (ciudad_id, lat)
CREATE INDEX espacio_ubicacion_idx ON espacio (ubicacion_id)
CREATE INDEX campania_ciudad_ciudad_id_idx ON campania_ciudad (ciudad_id)
CREATE INDEX zona_campania_ciudad_idx ON zona (campania_ciudad_id)
CREATE INDEX zona_vertice_zona_idx ON zona_vertice (zona_id, orden)
CREATE INDEX audit_log_evento_uuid_idx ON audit_log (evento, uuid)
CREATE INDEX sync_queue_estado_orden ON sync_queue (state, created_at, id)
CREATE INDEX sync_queue_fila ON sync_queue (entity, row_pk)
CREATE INDEX sync_queue_done_at ON sync_queue (state, done_at)
CREATE INDEX espacio_persona_espacio_idx ON espacio_persona (espacio_id)
CREATE INDEX espacio_persona_persona_idx ON espacio_persona (persona_id)
CREATE INDEX nota_objetivo_idx ON nota (target_type, target_id)
CREATE INDEX agenda_colportor_idx ON agenda (colportor_id, fecha_programada)
CREATE INDEX agenda_espacio_persona_idx ON agenda (espacio_persona_id)
CREATE INDEX agenda_espacio_idx ON agenda (espacio_id)
CREATE INDEX visita_colportor_idx ON visita (colportor_id, fecha)
CREATE INDEX visita_espacio_persona_idx ON visita (espacio_persona_id)
CREATE INDEX visita_espacio_idx ON visita (espacio_id)
CREATE INDEX notificacion_historial_recibida_idx ON notificacion_historial (recibida_en)
CREATE INDEX producto_coleccion_coleccion_idx ON producto_coleccion (coleccion_id)
CREATE INDEX precio_por_ciudad_campania_ciudad_idx ON precio_por_ciudad (campania_ciudad_id)
CREATE INDEX precio_por_ciudad_producto_idx ON precio_por_ciudad (producto_id)
CREATE INDEX precio_por_ciudad_coleccion_idx ON precio_por_ciudad (coleccion_id)
CREATE INDEX precio_general_producto_idx ON precio_general (producto_id)
CREATE INDEX precio_general_coleccion_idx ON precio_general (coleccion_id)
